description: This Swift source file contains an extension for the VoiceWakeOverlayController class, implementing methods for presenting, managing, and dismissing overlay windows related to voice wake functionality on macOS. It includes UI setup, window positioning, and interaction handling.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Handles presenting the overlay window, configuring the view and managing window visibility.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Initializes the overlay window if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: bringToFrontIfVisible
methods.description: Brings the overlay window to the front if it is visible.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates the target frame for the overlay window based on the current screen.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the window's frame, optionally with animation.

methods.name: measuredHeight
methods.description: Calculates and returns the height of the overlay based on its content.

methods.name: dismissTargetFrame
methods.description: Determines the frame to animate to when dismissing, based on reason and outcome.
